title: STARTEX: MV Halcyon Dawn Clears Cozumel

fields.location: MV Halcyon Dawn, outbound from Cozumel, Mexico, bound for Galveston, Texas
fields.weather: Clear, 27°C. Wind east 12 knots, seas 3 to 4 feet.
fields.load: Full sailing: 2,980 passengers and 1,120 crew, as confirmed by the Purser at embarkation
fields.staffing: Full shipboard complement on duty. Shoreside crisis team not stood up.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 18:00 Central ship time on Thursday, February 18, 2027, and MV Halcyon Dawn has just cleared Cozumel on schedule. This is day 5 of the seven-night western Caribbean voyage that left Galveston on Sunday, February 14. Arrival in Galveston is 07:00 Sunday, February 21. Ship's systems and navigation are normal, second seating is open in the dining rooms, and Friday is a sea day with the formal-night gala. Stage 1 enhanced measures for acute gastroenteritis have been running since Wednesday. For the next hour, Thursday evening through Friday morning will be compressed.

status.name: Navigation and propulsion
status.note: Normal. Sailed Cozumel 18:00. Galveston arrival 07:00 Sun Feb 21 on schedule.

status.name: Hotel operations and dining
status.note: Dining rooms open for second seating. Friday is a sea day: formal night and gala.

status.name: Acute gastroenteritis measures
status.note: Stage 1 (1 percent) since Wednesday: public areas cleaned every 2 hours, written notices to guests, masks available, no shared serving utensils.

status.name: Medical log and denominators
status.note: Hotel Director's board shows 2,980 passengers and 1,120 crew. All percentages use these numbers.

status.name: Shoreside crisis team
status.note: Not stood up. Fleet Operations and Public Health ashore can be reached by phone.

status.name: Next voyage turnaround
status.note: 2,980 booked guests have been told check-in opens 13:00 Sun Feb 21 and boarding starts at 14:00.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before reading, confirm each role knows its seat and has the medical log and HOPRPG stage table. After reading, have every role confirm the denominators and note that the 24-hour report window runs from 19:00 Friday to 07:00 Saturday ship time, with the 4-hour update due by 03:00 Sunday.
fields.scenarioTitle: Same Count, Every Channel: Norovirus Thresholds, Reporting & Turnaround

instructorNote: Sets the baseline. Watch for every role confirming the same denominators (2,980 passengers, 1,120 crew) and working the reporting clocks back from the 07:00 Sunday Galveston arrival before anyone looks at case numbers.
